# GitHub Topics & Discoverability

This file documents the recommended GitHub repository **topics** and **discoverability settings** for the EU AI Act Toolkit.

> **Action required:** Set these topics in GitHub → Repository Settings → Topics.

## Recommended GitHub Topics

```
eu-ai-act
ai-governance
compliance
legal-tech
ai-regulation
templates
checklists
gpai
high-risk-ai
sme
regulatory-compliance
artificial-intelligence
open-source
gdpr
```

## Awesome-List Submission Targets

The following curated lists are ideal submission targets. Use the entry text below directly.

---

### 1. `awesome-legal-tech` / `awesome-ai-governance`

**Entry format:**
```markdown
- [EU AI Act Toolkit](https://github.com/artemhobotun/EU-AI-Act-Toolkit) — Open-source collection of practical templates, checklists, and governance documents for EU AI Act compliance. Covers High-Risk AI, GPAI models, sector packs, and vendor due diligence. 100+ templates, MIT license.
```

---

### 2. EU AI Office Resource List

**Submission URL:** https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/european-ai-office  
**Submission type:** Community resource / practical tool  
**Entry text:**
> The EU AI Act Toolkit is an open-source GitHub repository providing practical readiness templates, checklists, and governance documentation for organisations seeking to understand and prepare for EU AI Act obligations. It covers High-Risk AI systems, GPAI model documentation, sector-specific guidance, and vendor due diligence — designed for SMEs and legal professionals.

---

### 3. `papers-with-code` / ML research registries

**Note:** Once a Zenodo DOI is obtained via `CITATION.cff`, the toolkit can be registered as a software artifact in academic indexes.

---

### 4. Product Hunt / Hacker News

**Tagline for launch post:**
> EU AI Act Toolkit — 100+ free templates and checklists to prepare for the EU AI Act. Open source, MIT, no registration.

**Key categories:** Legal Tech · Compliance · Open Source

---

## SEO Metadata (already implemented in site)

All pages include:
- `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image` (1200×630 SVG social card)
- Twitter Card `summary_large_image`
- Semantic HTML with proper heading hierarchy
- Descriptive `<meta name="description">` per page
